'''Aitan Brewgs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on the [[Eternal Empire]] capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zakuul]]. He was a member of the [[Heralds of Zildrog]], a cult worshipping the mythical serpent-god [[Zildrog]] that controlled the [[Old World]] of Zakuul. In [[3631 BBY]] Brewgs was alerted by [[Reg]] that a member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] was in the Old World, which was against the deal made between Emperor [[Arcann]] and [[the Exalted]]. With two other Heralds, Brewgs confronted the Knight [[Senya Tirall]] in the [[Platform 6 cantina]], but arrival of [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] turned the tide and all three Heralds were killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aitan Brewgs appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows'''.
